name: Gabay Group
summary: Gabay Group develops, constructs, and markets real estate properties in Israel. It undertakes residential development and urban renewal projects. The company also holds income-producing real estate, such as hotels, commercial centers, and retirement communities. The company was formerly known as Hof Hayam Hakachol Ltd. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Bnei Brak, Israel.
